CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Specimen Type: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Rule out Down syndrome

TEST PERFORMED
Chromosome Analysis, G-banded Karyotype

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested, and G-banded according to standard protocols. Twenty metaphase cells were analyzed. Analysis was performed at approximately 400-450 band resolution.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype. No evidence of trisomy 21 or other numerical or structural chromosomal abnormalities detected.

INTERPRETATION
This analysis excludes Down syndrome (trisomy 21). The resolution of this study is sufficient to detect numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements. Subtle chromosomal abnormalities below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics cannot be excluded.

Authorized by: [redacted name], Ph.D., FACMG
Laboratory Director
